application_problem: Heterogeneous transport and picker resources must jointly serve warehouse orders
engineering_challenge: A service decision needs complementary roles and an order, while independent proposals can compete for the same resource or order
method_mechanism: Capacity-aware AGV-picker-task candidates and autoregressive exclusive reservation
experimental_evidence: Six training seeds exist for CHORD and three reservation/capacity ablations. CAHR structurally produces zero same-role duplicate proposals under the current contention definition.
supported_claim: The decoder constructs one-step mutually exclusive role-task coalitions and its probability is used by PPO.
remaining_gap: This does not prove global matching optimality, collision-free motion, aisle safety, or superior deadline behavior.

application_problem: Warehouse resource and order sets change during operation
engineering_challenge: Fixed-identity/fixed-action policies do not directly represent changing active sets
method_mechanism: Shared entity encoders, active masks, task pointer actions and population/load features
experimental_scenario: in_distribution; unseen_small; unseen_large; picker_shift; fixed_team_dynamic_orders; robot_breakdown
experimental_evidence: All five learned methods have six trained seeds and 100 episodes per seed/scenario in Core8.
supported_claim: The policy can be evaluated zero-shot on held-out active-set sizes and event regimes within configured capacities.
remaining_gap: Arrays remain capped at 24 AGVs, 12 pickers and 80 tasks; unbounded openness is unsupported.

application_problem: Multiple resources and orders participate in task- and zone-level relationships
engineering_challenge: Pairwise adjacency can discard which entities belong to the same higher-order relation
method_mechanism: Task-coalition and shared-zone incidence with node-hyperedge-node aggregation
experimental_evidence: CHORD is compared with Entity+CAHR and Graph+CAHR at six seeds; point means are mostly favorable but all 24 selected-scene primary intervals cross zero.
supported_claim: The implementation preserves task/zone hyperedge identity, unlike its binary 2-section control.
remaining_gap: Strong empirical necessity is not established. Pair structural argument with qualified directional evidence.

application_problem: Role imbalance changes which orders can form complete service teams
engineering_challenge: Raw entity embeddings do not explicitly expose feasible role supply, load and distance
method_mechanism: Ten-dimensional capacity/load descriptor enters coalition scoring and critic receives eight population/load features
experimental_evidence: Capacity/reservation ablations are complete for six seeds in three scenes. Full CHORD has best service/throughput/flow point means; capacity-factorized has lower deadline-miss point means.
supported_claim: Capacity context contributes to an operational trade-off under role imbalance.
remaining_gap: The individual capacity contribution is not uniformly positive and most six-seed effect intervals are inconclusive.

application_problem: Resource breakdown and picker shift require reassignment under reduced service capacity
engineering_challenge: Assignments and feasible coalitions must change when resources leave and re-enter
method_mechanism: Active masks, forced deactivation/release, capacity restoration and dynamic reconstruction of incidence/candidates
metric: service_level; throughput_per_100_steps; deadline_miss_rate; mean_flow_time; forced_failures; repairs; shift_changes
experimental_evidence: Core8 includes both scenarios for six training seeds and 100 episodes per seed/scenario.
supported_claim: The policy is evaluated under simulated resource-availability events without retraining.
remaining_gap: Repair restores capacity, not guaranteed identity; base random joins remain enabled; no hardware fault model.

application_problem: Dynamic demand creates changing feasible action sets and deadlines
engineering_challenge: Orders arrive, cancel or expire while resources remain occupied
method_mechanism: Task masks/pointer actions, arrival process, cancellation/expiration and action-feasibility masks
experimental_evidence: Core8 dynamic-order evidence is complete; demand_050/100/200/350 sensitivity is still incomplete.
supported_claim: The implemented simulator directly tests dynamic order sets and deadline pressure.
remaining_gap: Demand sensitivity is not ready; task-slot admission/rejection is not exported, so demand_350 saturation cannot yet be diagnosed.

application_problem: The executed joint assignment should match the distribution optimized during training
engineering_challenge: An external conflict resolver after independent action sampling would change the executed joint distribution
method_mechanism: Stored conditional sequence, masks and round indicators; exact sum of conditional log probabilities; state-level PPO ratio
experimental_evidence: Six-seed mechanism runs exist. Full CHORD is operationally strong but deadline-miss trade-offs remain.
supported_claim: The implemented PPO objective is aligned with the sampled reservation sequence.
remaining_gap: This is a structural implementation fact, not proof of global PPO convergence or an unbiased clipped surrogate.

application_problem: Operators need some indication of which coordination relations affect a decision
engineering_challenge: A black-box joint policy gives no semantic relationship-level sensitivity
method_mechanism: Post-hoc masking of task or zone hyperedges and measurement of score/probability/value changes
metric: absolute probability change; top-edge change; value change; event snapshots
experimental_evidence: Three training seeds with 20 fixed evaluation episodes each are currently present.
supported_claim: The model supports semantic collaboration-structure attribution as an exploratory case study.
remaining_gap: Not physical causality; only three seeds; background events occur between snapshots; no human usefulness study.

application_problem: An application paper needs comparison with both learning and operations alternatives
engineering_challenge: Performance gains might come from openness support, relation encoding, decoder design or simply learning versus optimization
method_mechanism: PLATO-faithful, MOHITO-official adapter, Entity-MAPPO, Graph-MAPPO and rolling-horizon MILP
metric: four primary operational metrics plus diagnostics
experimental_evidence: Main learned comparison has six seeds. CHORD leads learned point means in 30/32 cells; 81/128 oriented bootstrap intervals are positive and 47 cross zero. Rolling MILP remains competitive in unseen_small and picker_heavy_ratio.
supported_claim: CHORD has a generally favorable learned-baseline profile under the implemented protocol.
remaining_gap: No Holm-adjusted exact sign-flip test is below 0.05; MILP is not uniformly dominated; MOHITO cadence adaptation must be disclosed.

application_problem: Engineering relevance requires defensible parameter realism
engineering_challenge: Arbitrary simulation rates can make application conclusions non-transferable
method_mechanism: Planned calibration table and dose-response sensitivity
experimental_evidence: The calibration table exists but all ten rows are TODO; sensitivity is still partial.
supported_claim: No external-validity claim is currently supported beyond an application-oriented controlled simulation.
remaining_gap: Populate literature/trace sources or label ranges explicitly; finish and audit sensitivity; export admission statistics.
